name: What happens during a professional garage insulation installation?

mainEntity.name: What happens during a professional garage insulation installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process starts with an inspection of the framing, electrical routing, and exterior moisture barriers. Next, gaps and penetrations around sill plates, electrical boxes, and framing joints are sealed with caulk or expanding foam to stop air leaks. Installers then cut and fit insulation batts snugly between the studs without over-compressing the material, maintaining full R-value. Finally, the perimeter is prepared for drywall installation or inspection depending on the scope of the remodel.
acceptedAnswer.description: The crew air-seals wall gaps, cuts and fits insulation snugly between framing studs without compression, and prepares the space for wall coverings.
